items.description: Tabs with a measured sliding underline, icons, counts and crossfading panels.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tabs with id, label, content and optional icon and count.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab id when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab id.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: fitted
props.description: Stretch the tabs to share the full width.

props.name: color
props.description: Underline and focus ring color.

items.usage:
<TabsUnderline
  tabs={[
    { id: "overview", label: "Overview", content: "Project summary" },
    { id: "issues", label: "Issues", count: 12, content: "Open issues" },
  ]}
/>

items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Columns of cards you can drag between lists and reorder, with a placeholder slot and add buttons.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns with id, title and cards. Each card has id, title and optional tag and tone (a CSS color for the tag dot).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new columns after a drop, a keyboard move or an added card.

props.name: newCardLabel
props.description: Title given to cards created with the add button.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the drop slot and focus ring.

items.usage:
<KanbanBoard
  columns={[
    { id: "todo", title: "To do", cards: [{ id: "a", title: "Design review" }] },
    { id: "doing", title: "In progress", cards: [] },
    { id: "done", title: "Done", cards: [] },
  ]}
  onChange={(next) => console.log(next)}
/>

items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals an assistant reply word by word with a blinking cursor. Supports bold, inline code and line breaks. The server render shows the full text.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to reveal. Supports **bold**, `inline code` and newlines.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per step.

props.name: chunk
props.description: Characters revealed per step. 0 reveals one word per step.

props.name: start
props.description: Begin streaming. While false the text stays empty after mount.

props.name: color
props.description: Cursor color.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Show the blinking cursor while streaming.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once the last step is revealed.

items.usage: <StreamingText text="Deploy **482** is live. Run `relay logs` to follow it." />

items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A scrolling conversation with user and assistant bubbles, avatars, timestamps, a streaming last reply, a typing indicator and auto-scroll to the newest message.

props.name: messages
props.type: { id: string; role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"; content: string; time?: string; streaming?: boolean }[]
props.description: Messages in order. Content supports **bold**, `inline code` and newlines. Set streaming on the last assistant message to reveal it progressively.

props.name: userName
props.description: Name used for the user avatar initials.

props.name: assistantName
props.description: Name used for the assistant avatar initials and typing label.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Custom avatar content. Defaults to initials.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in pixels before the thread scrolls.

props.name: typing
props.description: Show the assistant typing indicator after the last message.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color of user bubbles.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per word for a streaming message.

items.usage: <ChatThread messages={[{ id: "1", role: "user", content: "Hello" }, { id: "2", role: "assistant", content: "Hi, how can I help?" }]} />

items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: A collapsible card for a tool invocation with status, duration, syntax-colored arguments and result, and a copy button.

props.name: name
props.description: Tool name shown in the header.

props.name: status
props.description: Shows a spinner, a check or a cross.

props.name: duration
props.description: Elapsed time. Numbers are milliseconds and render as 420ms or 1.2s.

props.name: args
props.description: Arguments, rendered as JSON-like text. JSON strings are pretty-printed.

props.name: result
props.description: Result, rendered like args, with a copy button.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start expanded.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus and running-state accent.

items.usage: <ToolCallCard name="search_docs" duration={420} args={{ query: "rollback" }} result={{ hits: 3 }} defaultOpen />

items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: A compact thinking state that cycles through phrases with a fade, as a shimmering label or breathing dots, with an optional elapsed timer.

props.name: phrases
props.description: Labels to cycle through.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between phrases.

props.name: showTimer
props.description: Show elapsed time next to the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shimmering label, or breathing dots beside a plain label.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot color for the dots variant.

items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: A chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, attach and mic buttons, a model picker and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

props.name: models
props.description: Models offered in the picker.

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Initially selected model. Defaults to the first entry.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows the textarea grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the textarea.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the whole composer.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus ring and send button color.

props.name: attachIcon
props.description: Replaces the default attach icon.

props.name: micIcon
props.description: Replaces the default mic icon.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called when the attach button is pressed.

props.name: onMic
props.description: Called when the mic button is pressed.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text and the selected model. The field clears afterwards.

items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: A vertical plan or trace with pending, active, done and failed steps joined by a connector line that fills as steps complete.

props.name: steps
props.type: { id: string; title: string; detail?: string; status?: "pending" | "active" | "done" | "failed" }[]
props.description: Steps in order. A step status overrides activeIndex.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Steps before it are done, it is active, the rest are pending.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent for the spinner, check and connector fill.

props.name: compact
props.description: Tighter spacing and smaller text.

items.usage: <AgentSteps activeIndex={1} steps={[{ id: "a", title: "Read config" }, { id: "b", title: "Run checks" }, { id: "c", title: "Ship" }]} />

items.title: Like Burst
items.description: A heart button that fills with a bouncy pop, scatters a ring of particles and rolls its count to the new value.

props.name: count
props.description: Total count at the initial liked state. Liking adds one to it, unliking takes it back.

props.name: liked
props.description: Controlled liked state. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultLiked
props.description: Initial liked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every toggle with the new liked state and the new count.

props.name: color
props.description: Heart fill, ring and particle color.

props.name: size
props.description: Heart size in pixels. The button and count scale with it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle button.

items.title: Review Card
items.description: A customer review with avatar, half-star rating, a Read more clamp, a verified badge and a helpful vote.

props.name: rating
props.description: Rating from 0 to 5. Rounded to the nearest half star.

props.name: name
props.description: Reviewer name. Also seeds the initials avatar color.

props.name: date
props.description: Date text shown at the top right. Hidden when empty.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline next to the stars.

props.name: text
props.description: Review body. Clamped to `lines` with a Read more toggle when it overflows.

props.name: verified
props.description: Show the Verified badge next to the name.

props.name: helpful
props.description: Starting helpful count. The vote button toggles one more on top.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar image URL. Initials are shown when missing or when the image fails to load.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines shown before the Read more toggle appears.

items.usage: <ReviewCard name="Maya J." rating={4.5} title="Worth it" text="Arrived early and healthy." verified helpful={12} />

items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N tail. Hovering spreads them apart and shows a name tooltip.

props.name: people
props.type: { name: string; image?: string; color?: string }[]
props.description: People to show. Without an image the initials render on a color derived from the name, or on `color` when given.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar diameter in pixels.

props.name: max
props.description: Most avatars to show. Anyone beyond it moves into the +N tail.

props.name: ring
props.description: Color of the ring around each avatar. Match it to the surface behind the stack.

props.name: extra
props.description: People you know about but did not list. Added to the +N tail.

items.usage: <AvatarStack people={[{ name: "Ada Lovelace" }, { name: "Alan Turing" }]} extra={12} />

items.title: Share Row
items.description: A row of share pills with monochrome glyphs that pick up each platform's accent on hover, a copy-link pill and a native share button.

props.name: links
props.description: Pills to render. Share URLs are built from title, url and text unless href is given. The copy pill briefly reads Copied.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title used for the post text, email subject and native share sheet.

props.name: url
props.description: URL to share. Falls back to the current page address when empty.

props.name: text
props.description: Extra message text for the post, email body and native share sheet.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hide the pill labels and keep only the glyphs. Labels stay available to screen readers and as tooltips.

items.usage: <ShareRow title="Notes from the greenhouse" url={postUrl} links={[{ id: "x" }, { id: "email" }, { id: "copy" }]} />

items.title: Rating Summary
items.description: The average rating as a big number with stars and review total, beside five bars that fill in on mount.

props.name: counts
props.type: { 5: number; 4: number; 3: number; 2: number; 1: number } | number[]
props.description: Review counts per star level. An array is read from five stars down to one star.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the stars and bar fills.

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Show a percentage at the end of each bar. When false the raw count is shown.

items.title: Navbar Glass
items.description: A frosted glass navbar with a sliding hover pill, a keyboard-navigable mega menu and a hamburger layout that takes over in narrow containers.

props.name: logo
props.description: Content of the logo slot. Defaults to a small mark with the Hyperblur name.

props.name: links
props.type: { id: string; label: string; href?: string; menu?: { title: string; description?: string; href?: string; icon?: IconName | ReactNode }[] }[]
props.description: Navigation links. A link with a `menu` array opens the mega menu panel. Built-in icon names: bolt, chart, shield, code, users, book, globe, layers.

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void } | null
props.description: Primary call to action on the right. Pass null to hide it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the call to action, the menu icons and the focus rings.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks the navbar to the top of its scroll container. Set false for a static position.

props.name: defaultOpenId
props.description: Id of a link whose mega menu starts open. Escape, an outside click or focus leaving the navbar closes it.

items.title: Footer Columns
items.description: A full website footer with a brand blurb, social buttons, link columns, a newsletter mini-form, legal links and a live status pill.

props.name: logo
props.description: Content of the logo slot. Defaults to a small mark with the Hyperblur name.

props.name: blurb
props.default: "Build, ship and measure product experiments from one workspace your whole team can trust."
props.description: Short description under the logo.

props.name: socials
props.description: Social icon buttons.

props.name: columns
props.type: { title: string; links: { label: string; href?: string }[] }[]
props.description: Link columns. Three or four work best. They collapse to two columns, then one, as the container narrows.

props.name: newsletter
props.description: Shows the email mini-form under the blurb.

props.name: newsletterTitle
props.description: Label above the mini-form.

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Called with the trimmed email after it passes validation.

props.name: legal
props.description: Links in the bottom bar.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Copyright line in the bottom bar.

props.name: status
props.type: { label: string; tone?: "ok" | "warn" | "down"; href?: string } | null
props.description: Status pill with a pulsing dot. Pass an href to make it a link, or null to hide it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of hover states, the subscribe button and focus rings.

items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: A slim banner that rotates through messages with a vertical slide, pauses on hover and can be dismissed.

props.name: messages
props.type: { text: string; badge?: string; cta?: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: Messages to show. With more than one, they rotate. `cta` renders an arrow link pointing at `href`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Solid and gradient use the accent color, subtle sits on a dark surface.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each message stays on screen. Set 0 to stop rotating. Rotation is also off when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows the dismiss button. Dismissal lives in component state only.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the bar. Use it to persist the choice yourself.

props.name: accent
props.description: Base color of the solid and gradient variants and of the subtle variant highlights.

items.usage: <AnnouncementBar variant="gradient" messages={[{ text: "Version 2.0 is live.", cta: "Read more", href: "/blog" }]} />

items.title: Cookie Banner
items.description: A consent card with Accept all, Reject non-essential and a Customize panel of category switches. It slides up on mount.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card.

props.name: description
props.default: "We use cookies to run the site and understand how it is used. Choose what you allow."
props.description: Short explanation under the heading.

props.name: placement
props.description: Inline renders in the page flow. The bottom placements fix the card to the viewport.

props.name: defaultPreferences
props.description: Initial state of the optional category switches. Necessary is always on.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (preferences: { necessary: true; analytics: boolean; marketing: boolean }) => void
props.description: Called once when the user accepts, rejects or saves custom choices.

props.name: policyHref
props.description: When set, adds a Cookie policy link after the description.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the primary button, the switches and the focus rings.

items.title: Newsletter Signup
items.description: An email capture block with inline validation and shake, a spinner while submitting and a success state that morphs the button into a check.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Pass an element to style it your own way.

props.name: description
props.default: "One short email every week with new features, product notes and what we are reading."
props.description: Helper text under the heading.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Label of the submit button.

props.name: successMessage
props.default: "You are in. Check your inbox to confirm."
props.description: Message shown inside the field after a successful submit.

props.name: privacyNote
props.description: Small note under the form.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the heading, text and note.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the submit button and the focus ring.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed email once it is valid. While a returned promise is pending the button shows a spinner. A rejection shows an inline error.

items.usage: <NewsletterSignup onSubmit={async (email) => { await fetch('/api/subscribe', { method: 'POST', body: email }); }} />

items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb trail that truncates long labels and folds the middle of deep paths into an ellipsis menu.

props.name: items
props.description: Trail from the root to the current page. The last item renders as the current page and is not a link.

props.name: separator
props.description: Glyph between items.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Most items shown before the middle ones collapse into an ellipsis button that opens a small menu. Minimum 2.

props.name: maxLabelWidth
props.description: Widest a label can be in pixels before it truncates with an ellipsis.

props.name: homeIcon
props.description: Shows a home icon in place of the first label. The label stays as the accessible name.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the focus rings.

items.usage: <Breadcrumbs homeIcon items={[{ label: "Home", href: "/" }, { label: "Docs", href: "/docs" }, { label: "Setup" }]} />

items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with ellipsis collapsing, an indicator that slides between pages and a compact variant with a page select.

props.name: total
props.description: Total number of pages.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled current page, starting at 1. Pair with onPageChange.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Initial page when uncontrolled.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page whenever it changes.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page before collapsing into an ellipsis.

props.name: boundaries
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and at the end of the list.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the buttons: 28, 34 or 40 pixels.

props.name: variant
props.description: Numbered buttons, or a compact Page N of M control with a select.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the active page indicator and focus ring.

items.title: Dialog Modal
items.description: An accessible modal with a blurred scrim, scale-and-fade transitions, a focus trap and focus returned to the trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Also names the dialog through aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title. Wired to aria-describedby.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content, usually buttons. A function receives a close callback.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Label for a built-in trigger button. Omit it to open the dialog from your own state.

props.name: container
props.description: viewport covers the screen through a portal. parent fills the nearest positioned ancestor.

props.name: variant
props.description: destructive adds a warning badge and a red accent.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Close when Escape is pressed inside the dialog.

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the close button in the corner.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the dialog on open. An element with data-autofocus wins over the first focusable one.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum panel width in pixels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Focus ring color.

items.usage: <DialogModal trigger="Open" title="Rename project" description="Pick a new name." footer={(close) => <DialogButton tone="primary" onClick={close}>Save</DialogButton>} />

items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A button-triggered menu driven by a data array, with icons, shortcuts, checkbox items, a side submenu and the full keyboard model.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries: item, checkbox, separator, label or submenu. Items take id, label, icon, shortcut, disabled and destructive.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Content of the trigger button. A string also gets a chevron.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger when it only holds an icon.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the id of the chosen action item.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with.

props.name: side
props.description: auto flips the menu above the trigger when there is no room below.

props.name: size
props.description: Item height: 24 or 32 pixels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Focus ring and checkbox tick color.

items.usage: <DropdownMenu trigger="Actions" items={[{ id: "rename", label: "Rename", shortcut: "R" }, { type: "separator" }, { id: "delete", label: "Delete", destructive: true }]} />

items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file upload area with an animated dashed drag-over border, type and size checks, inline errors and a file list with simulated progress. It never uploads anything.

props.name: accept
props.description: Comma-separated extensions or MIME types, for example .png,.jpg,.pdf. Empty accepts any file.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file size in bytes.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files kept in the list at once.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several files. When false, a new file replaces the current one.

props.name: simulate
props.description: Animate a fake upload progress for each added file. Without it files show as ready immediately.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Block drops, clicks and keyboard browsing.

props.name: title
props.description: Main line inside the zone.

props.name: hint
props.description: Second line. Defaults to a summary of the accepted types and the size limit.

props.name: size
props.description: sm turns the zone into a compact horizontal strip.

props.name: accent
props.description: Drag-over border, icon and progress color.

props.name: defaultFiles
props.type: { name: string; size: number; progress?: number }[]
props.description: Files shown at the start. Their progress stays where you set it.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the accepted File objects. Send them wherever you like.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with the files that failed the type, size or count checks.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when a file is removed from the list.

items.title: Empty State
items.description: A zero-data state with four floating inline illustrations, a title, a description and primary and secondary actions.

props.name: illustration
props.description: Built-in illustration. none hides it.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Pass a styled node to change the typeface.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting sentence under the title.

props.name: primaryAction
props.type: { label: string; onClick?: () => void; href?: string }
props.description: Filled pill button. Renders a link when href is set.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.type: { label: string; onClick?: () => void; href?: string }
props.description: Quiet ghost button next to the primary one.

props.name: size
props.description: sm shrinks the artwork, spacing and type for small panels.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used inside the illustrations and for the focus ring.

items.usage: <EmptyState illustration="search" title="No results" description="Try a different keyword." primaryAction={{ label: "Clear filters" }} />

items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering loading placeholders: a rect, circle and text primitive. SkeletonCard, SkeletonList and SkeletonProfile ship in the same file.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the placeholder.

props.name: width
props.description: Width. Numbers are pixels. For circle it is the diameter.

props.name: height
props.description: Height. Defaults to 96 for rect and 12 per line for text.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of lines for the text variant.

props.name: lastLineWidth
props.description: Width of the final text line when there are several.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of rect and text blocks.

props.name: animate
props.description: Run the shimmer sweep. With reduced motion it pulses gently instead.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the blocks.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Color of the shimmer band.

props.name: label
props.description: Makes the placeholder a labelled status region for screen readers. Composites default to Loading.

props.name: SkeletonCard
props.type: { media?: boolean; mediaHeight?: number; lines?: number }
props.description: Composite props on top of animate, color, highlight and label. media toggles the image block, mediaHeight is in pixels and lines sets the text lines.

props.name: SkeletonList
props.description: Composite props on top of animate, color, highlight and label. Defaults are 3 rows and a 36 pixel avatar.

items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A multi-axis radar chart with up to three translucent series, grid rings, point tooltips and a legend that hides or shows each series.

props.name: axes
props.description: Axis labels, drawn clockwise from the top.

props.name: series
props.type: { name: string; values: number[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: Series to plot. Each values array lines up with axes by index. Any number works, three reads best.

props.name: max
props.description: Value at the outer ring. Rounded up from the highest value when omitted.

props.name: rings
props.description: Number of concentric grid rings.

props.name: colors
props.description: Palette used by series that have no color of their own.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in viewBox units. The width follows the container.

props.name: legend
props.description: Where the toggle legend sits. Each entry is a button that hides or shows its series.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats values in the tooltip and the accessible label.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the polygons from the center on mount.

items.title: Heatmap Calendar
items.description: A GitHub-style activity grid with month and weekday labels, an intensity legend and a hover tooltip with date and count. Ships a deterministic sampleActivity helper.

props.name: values
props.description: Counts by ISO date (2026-10-31), or an array whose last item is endDate and runs back one day per entry. Uses sampleActivity() when omitted.

props.name: endDate
props.description: Last day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD. Pass today's date from the server or an effect to keep rendering deterministic.

props.name: weeks
props.description: Number of week columns.

props.name: colors
props.description: Intensity scale from empty to busiest. Any length of two or more.

props.name: unit
props.description: Singular noun used in the tooltip and summary.

props.name: showTotal
props.description: Show the total count under the grid.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the Less to More legend.

props.name: animate
props.description: Fade the columns in from left to right on mount.

items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A conversion funnel of centered trapezoid stages with absolute values, share of the first stage and the drop-off between stages.

props.name: stages
props.type: { label: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: Stages from top to bottom. Percentages are measured against the first stage.

props.name: colors
props.description: Fill per stage, in order. Used when a stage has no color.

props.name: stageHeight
props.description: Height of each stage row in viewBox units.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats the absolute values. Defaults to grouped digits.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the stages in one after another on mount.

props.name: height

props.name: colors

props.name: showVolume
props.description: Show the volume strip under the price panel.

props.name: volumeFormatter
props.description: Formats volume in the tooltip. Defaults to compact notation.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the candles in from left to right on mount.

items.title: People List
items.description: A team directory with initials avatars, presence dots, role badges, a keyboard-friendly row menu and a search field with an animated empty state.

props.name: people
props.type: { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string; status?: "online" | "away" | "offline" }[]
props.description: People to list. Avatar color is derived from the name. Owner and Admin roles get a colored badge.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show the search field above the rows. It filters by name, email and role.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search field.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color used for focus rings and the open-row highlight.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when a menu item is chosen. Remove also takes the row out of the list and Invite adds an Invited chip.

items.title: File List
items.description: Files and folders with a list and grid view, type-colored icons, multi-select checkboxes and a selection toolbar that slides in.

props.name: files
props.type: { id: string; name: string; kind: FileKind; size?: string; modified: string }[]
props.description: Items to show. kind is one of folder, image, doc, sheet, code, video, audio, archive or pdf.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown next to the item count.

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled view mode. Pair with onViewChange.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initial view mode when uncontrolled.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when the view toggle changes.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled list of selected file ids. Pair with onSelectionChange.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initially selected file ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called whenever the selection changes.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when Download is pressed in the selection toolbar.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called when Delete is pressed. The selected files are removed from the list.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color for checkboxes and the selected state.

items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: A ranked list with medals for the top three, proportional score bars that grow in, rank change arrows and a pinned row for the current user.

props.name: entries
props.type: { id: string; name: string; score: number; change?: number; you?: boolean }[]
props.description: Scored entries in any order. They are sorted by score. change is the number of places gained (positive) or lost (negative). you marks the current user.

props.name: topN
props.description: How many ranks to show. If the current user ranks lower, their row is pinned below a divider.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown after each score. Pass an empty string to hide it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Bar color and the highlight on the current user's row.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: When provided, rows become buttons and call this with the entry and its rank.

items.title: Transaction List
items.description: Transactions grouped under sticky day headings, with merchant tiles, status chips, tabular amounts and an expandable detail row with a copy button.

props.name: transactions
props.type: { id: string; day: string; merchant: string; category: string; time: string; amount: number; status?: "pending" | "posted"; reference?: string; account?: string }[]
props.description: Transactions in display order. Rows with the same day are grouped under one heading. Negative amounts are spending, positive amounts are income.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code used to format amounts.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height in pixels at which the list starts to scroll.

props.name: surface
props.description: Background color of the sticky day headings. Match it to the surface behind the list.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color for focus rings and the expanded row.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Id of a transaction whose detail row starts open.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after a reference id is copied.

items.title: Inbox List
items.description: Email-style rows with unread dots, star toggles, checkboxes, hover quick actions that replace the time and j/k keyboard navigation.

props.name: messages
props.type: { id: string; sender: string; subject: string; preview: string; time: string; unread?: boolean; starred?: boolean }[]
props.description: Messages to show, newest first.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown in the header next to the unread count.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the unread dot, checkboxes and selected rows.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called for every action. Archive, Snooze and Delete also remove the rows with a collapse animation.

items.title: Product Grid
items.description: A shop listing with an animated category chip row, sort select, result count and a container-responsive grid that reflows with a FLIP animation.

props.name: products
props.type: { id: string; name: string; category: string; price: number; rating: number; colors: [string, string]; shape?: "orb" | "arch" | "ring" | "bars" }[]
props.description: Products to list. Chips are built from the distinct categories. colors drive the gradient imagery.

props.name: allLabel
props.description: Label of the chip that clears the category filter.

props.name: category
props.description: Controlled active category. Pair with onCategoryChange.

props.name: defaultCategory
props.description: Initial category when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCategoryChange
props.description: Called when a chip is chosen.

props.name: sort
props.description: Controlled sort order. Pair with onSortChange.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort order when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when the sort select changes.

props.name: defaultFavorites
props.description: Ids of products that start with their heart filled.

props.name: onFavorite
props.description: Called when a heart is toggled.

props.name: density
props.description: Compact turns the cards into small horizontal rows for narrow spaces.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the active chip and focus rings.

items.title: Sortable List
items.description: A drag-to-reorder list with pointer dragging, siblings that slide out of the way, and full keyboard reordering with live announcements.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: string; meta?: string; tone?: "blue" | "green" | "amber" | "red" | "neutral" }[]
props.description: Items in their starting order. The list keeps its own order after each reorder.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the lifted row outline and the grip while dragging.

props.name: onReorder
props.type: (items: SortableItem[], from: number, to: number) => void
props.description: Called when an item is dropped in a new position, with the new order and the old and new indexes.

items.title: Sidebar Floating
items.description: A frosted, rounded sidebar inset from the page edge with labeled groups, an active pill that glides between items and a user card with a live status dot.

props.name: groups
props.type: { label?: string; items: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; badge?: string | number; href?: string }[] }[]
props.description: Navigation groups. Items render as links when `href` is set and as buttons otherwise. The label letter stands in when `icon` is missing.

props.name: active
props.description: Controlled active item id. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Initial active item id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when an item is chosen.

props.name: brand
props.description: Content shown above the navigation, such as a logo and product name.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; color?: string; status?: "online" | "away" | "offline" } | null
props.description: User card at the bottom. Initials and avatar color come from the name unless `color` is given. Pass null to hide the card.

props.name: onUserClick
props.description: Called when the user card is pressed.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels, including the inset.

props.name: inset
props.description: Gap in pixels between the container edge and the glass panel.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each navigation row in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the active pill, badges and focus rings.

items.title: Sidebar Rail
items.description: A 56px icon rail. Hovering or focusing an item opens a flyout with its submenu, and items without a submenu show a tooltip. Arrow keys move through the rail.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; href?: string; links?: { id: string; label: string; badge?: string | number; href?: string }[] }[]
props.description: Rail items. An item with `links` opens a flyout, an item without them acts as a direct link or button.

props.name: active
props.description: Controlled active id. A rail item is highlighted when its own id or any of its link ids matches.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Initial active id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when an item or a flyout link is chosen.

props.name: openId
props.description: Controlled id of the item whose flyout is open. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpenId
props.description: Item whose flyout starts open when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a flyout opens or closes.

props.name: brand
props.description: Mark shown at the top of the rail.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content pinned to the bottom of the rail, such as an avatar.

props.name: flyoutWidth
props.description: Width of the flyout panel in pixels.

props.name: itemSize
props.description: Width and height of each rail button in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the active bar, markers and focus rings.

items.title: Sidebar Docs
items.description: Documentation navigation with a search field, collapsible groups that animate their height, nested links on a connected guide line and a marker that follows the active page.

props.name: groups
props.type: { id: string; title: string; items: { id: string; label: string; href?: string; badge?: string; children?: SidebarDocsLink[] }[] }[]
props.description: Groups of links. `badge` renders a small pill such as New. `children` render as an indented sub list.

props.name: active
props.description: Controlled active link id. Drive it from a scroll observer for scroll spy behavior. Its group opens and the link scrolls into view.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Initial active link id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a link is chosen.

props.name: openGroups
props.description: Controlled list of open group ids. Pair with onOpenGroupsChange.

props.name: defaultOpenGroups
props.description: Groups that start open when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenGroupsChange
props.description: Called when a group is opened or closed.

props.name: search
props.description: Show the search field. Typing filters links and opens every group with a match.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search field.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of group headers and links in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the active marker, badges and focus rings.

items.title: Sidebar Workspace
items.description: A workspace app sidebar with a keyboard-friendly workspace switcher, sections with counts, collapsible favorites, a usage card with an upgrade button and a user menu.

props.description: Workspaces listed in the switcher dropdown.

props.name: workspace

props.name: defaultWorkspace
props.description: Initial workspace id when uncontrolled.

props.description: Adds a Create workspace action to the dropdown when provided.

props.description: Called when a navigation item or favorite is chosen.

props.name: usage

props.name: upgradeLabel

props.name: onUpgrade
props.description: Called when the upgrade button is pressed.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email?: string; color?: string } | null

props.name: userMenu

props.description: Entries of the menu that opens from the user row.

props.name: onUserMenuSelect
props.description: Called when a user menu entry is chosen.

props.name: width
props.description: Sidebar width in pixels.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of navigation rows in pixels. The switcher and user row scale with it.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the progress bar, checkmark and focus rings.

props.name: footer

props.description: Called when an item is chosen.

props.name: rowHeight

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for badges, the active icon and focus rings.

items.title: Sidebar Tree
items.description: A file explorer tree with animated folders, colored file type icons, a filter field and the full tree keyboard model.

props.description: Tree data. A node with a `children` array is a folder, any other node is a file. Icons follow the file extension.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected node id. Pair with onSelect.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selected node id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a row is chosen with a click, Enter or Space.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled list of open folder ids. Pair with onExpandedChange.

props.description: Folders that start open when uncontrolled. The built-in sample project opens app and components.

props.description: Called when a folder opens or closes.

items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: Text with a band of light that glides across the glyphs on a loop, like a reflection passing over brushed metal.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds the highlight takes to cross the text. A short rest follows each pass.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the glyphs.

props.name: shine
props.description: Color of the moving highlight band.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Freeze the sweep while the pointer is over the text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the sweep off and show the text in the base color.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the highlight travels.

props.description: Card content.

props.name: color
props.description: Spotlight and border highlight color.

props.name: size
props.description: Spotlight radius in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Width of the border that lights up, in pixels.

props.name: idle

props.description: Number of meteors in the shower. Roughly a third are in flight at any moment.

props.description: Direction of travel in degrees. 0 moves right, 90 falls straight down, 145 heads down and to the left.

props.name: speed

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the meteors and stars.

props.name: stars
props.description: Number of twinkling background stars. 0 hides the star field.

props.name: seed
props.description: Changes the deterministic layout of meteors and stars.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier.

props.description: Film grain opacity from 0 to 1. 0 removes the grain layer.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius applied to the color fields, in pixels.

props.name: background
props.description: Base color behind the blobs.

props.description: Blend mode used where blobs overlap. Try "screen" for a brighter, pastel mix.

props.name: accent
props.description: Hub glow, ring highlight and hover color.

props.description: Content of the hub. Defaults to a gradient logo mark.

props.description: Node on the right that receives the hub beam.

props.description: How far the curves bow, from 0 (straight lines) to 1.

props.name: blur

props.description: Show the moving specular highlight and the lit rim.

props.name: radius
